1.name: Inexorable Descent
1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff5334|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2650|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw
1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light
1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2120|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4909|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

1.name: Conservation of Energy
1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff302|r Magicka and |cffffff385|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Font of Power
2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

3.name: Static Reverberation
3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1518|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.name: Calculated Defense
4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff8100|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Sphere of Influence
5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3681|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

1.name: Corrupting Bloody Mara
1.description:
Increase Max Magicka by |cffffff3937|r, Max Health by |cffffff4305|r, and Health Recovery by |cffffff430|r for |cffffff2|r hours. 
If you are a vampire, the tainted blood in this drink will also spark a fierce hunger in you.

1.name: Forceful
1.description: Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to |cffffff3|r other nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.

2.name: Heavy Weapons
2.description:
Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped:

Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff258|r.

Axes increase your Critical Damage done by |cffffff12|r%.

Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff2974|r.

3.name: Balanced Blade
3.description: Reduces the Stamina cost of your Two-Handed abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

4.name: Follow Up
4.description: When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, your damage done with Two Handed attacks increases by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

5.name: Battle Rush
5.description: Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds after killing a target.

6.name: Tri Focus
6.description:
Fully-charged Inferno Staff Heavy Attacks deal an additional |cffffff15250|r Flame Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Fully-charged Lightning Staff Heavy Attacks damage nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage done.

Fully-charged Ice Staff Heavy Attacks grant you a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff8100|r damage. This effect scales off your Max Health.

While an Ice Staff is equipped, blocking costs Magicka instead of Stamina.

7.name: Penetrating Magic
7.description: Your Destruction Staff abilities ignore |cffffff2974|r of the enemy's Spell Resistance.

8.name: Elemental Force
8.description: Increases your chance to apply status effects by |cffffff100|r%.

9.name: Ancient Knowledge
9.description:
Inferno Staves increases your damage done with damage over time and Status Effects by |cffffff12|r%.

Lightning Staves increases your damage done with direct damage and channeled effects by |cffffff12|r%.

Equipping an Ice Staff reduces the cost of blocking by |cffffff36|r% and increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff20|r%.

10.name: Destruction Expert
10.description:
When you kill an enemy with a Destruction Staff ability, you restore |cffffff3600|r Magicka.

When you absorb damage using a Destruction Staff Damage Shield, you restore |cffffff1800|r Magicka. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

11.name: Light Armor Bonuses
11.description:
Each piece of Light Armor does the following:

31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.description:

34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.

39.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2454|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Feed
54.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%

55.name: Dark Stalker
55.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Strike from the Shadows
56.description: When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff6|r seconds.

57.name: Undeath
57.description:
Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff15|r% based on your missing Health.

Current bonus: |cffffff1|r%

58.name: Blood Ritual
58.description:
Allows you to infect another player with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria once every |cffffffweek|r by returning to the Vampire ritual site. 

Players already infected with Lycanthropy cannot be infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria.

59.name: Unnatural Movement
59.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.

60.name: Blade of Woe
60.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

61.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
61.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

62.name: Padomaic Sprint
62.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

63.name: Shadowy Supplier
63.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

64.name: Shadow Rider
64.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

65.name: Spectral Assassin
65.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

66.name: Intimidating Presence
66.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Slayer
67.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

68.name: Banish the Wicked
68.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

69.name: Skilled Tracker
69.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

70.name: Bounty Hunter
70.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

71.name: Persuasive Will
71.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

72.name: Mage Adept
72.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

73.name: Everlasting Magic
73.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

74.name: Magicka Controller
74.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

75.name: Might of the Guild
75.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

76.name: See the Unseen
76.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

77.name: Clairvoyance
77.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

78.name: Spell Orb
78.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3814|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

79.name: Concentrated Barrier
79.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5000|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

80.name: Deliberation
80.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

81.name: Finders Keepers
81.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

82.name: Swiftly Forgotten
82.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

83.name: Haggling
83.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

84.name: Clemency
84.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

85.name: Timely Escape
85.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

86.name: Veil of Shadows
86.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

87.name: Undaunted Command
87.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff1059|r Health, |cffffff1027|r Stamina, and |cffffff807|r Magicka.

88.description:

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

90.name: Reach
90.description:

Any ability with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters is affected.

91.name: Combat Frenzy
91.description: You generate |cffffff20|r Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

92.name: Magicka Aid

98.name: Resourceful
98.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by |cffffff1000|r.

When you drink a potion, you restore |cffffff3125|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina.

1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3940|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6580|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3602|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2982|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10443|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff3940|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff8629|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor
5.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff18792|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3906|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

1.name: Master Assassin
1.description: Increases your Critical Chance rating against enemies you are flanking by |cffffff1448|r, increasing your chance to critically strike by |cffffff|6.6|r%.

2.name: Executioner
2.description: When an enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being damaged by you, you restore |cffffff1000|r Magicka and Stamina.

3.name: Pressure Points
3.description:
Increases your Critical Chance rating by |cffffff438|r for each Nightblade ability slotted, increasing your chance to critically strike by |cffffff2|r% per ability.

Current bonus: |cffffff438|r.

4.name: Hemorrhage
4.description:
Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%. 

Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff6|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Fated Fortune
5.description: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff7|r seconds.

6.name: Harnessed Quintessence
6.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.

7.name: Psychic Lesion
7.description: Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by |cffffff15|r% and Status Effect Chance by |cffffff55|r%.

8.name: Splintered Secrets
8.description:
What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff1240|r per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff4960|r.

1.name: Inexorable Descent
1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.

2.name: Booming Voice
2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.

3.name: Wildfire Embers
3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff5334|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.

4.name: Resolute Defense
4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.

5.name: Lead from the Front
5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

1.name: Abyssal Emergence
1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.

2.name: Fate Realigned
2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.

3.name: Unbound Potential
3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.

4.name: Erudite's Rigor
4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve
5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.name: Nothing Wasted
1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.

2.name: Malevolent Promise
2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.name: Cycle Unending
3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

4.name: Pound of Flesh
4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2650|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.name: Veil's Forfeit
5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

1.name: Tundra's Maw
1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Wild Adaptation
2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.

3.name: Glacial Obstinance
3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide
4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest
5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

1.name: Bastion of Light
1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2120|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.name: Devout Guardian
2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4909|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.name: Bright Harbinger
3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.

4.name: Judgment's Brand
4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.name: Steadfast Candescence
5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.

1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration
1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

2.name: An Eye for Exploitation
2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.

3.name: Above and Beyond
3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

4.name: Cutthroat's Focus
4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.

5.name: Share the Spoils
5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.

1.name: Conservation of Energy
1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff302|r Magicka and |cffffff385|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.

2.name: Font of Power
2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff14|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

3.name: Static Reverberation
3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1518|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

4.name: Calculated Defense
4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff8100|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Sphere of Influence
5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3681|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

1.name: Corrupting Bloody Mara
1.description:
Increase Max Magicka by |cffffff3937|r, Max Health by |cffffff4305|r, and Health Recovery by |cffffff430|r for |cffffff2|r hours. 
If you are a vampire, the tainted blood in this drink will also spark a fierce hunger in you.
1.effect:
Increase Max Magicka by |cffffff4620|r.
Increase Max Health by |cffffff5051|r.
Increase Health Recovery by |cffffff505|r.

6.effect: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

7.effect:
You are completely corrupted from the influence of Vampirism.

Health Recovery: -100%
Flame Damage Taken: +20%
Regular Ability Costs: +12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -24%

1.name: Forceful
1.description: Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to |cffffff3|r other nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.

2.name: Heavy Weapons
2.description:
Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped:

Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff258|r.

Axes increase your Critical Damage done by |cffffff12|r%.

Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff2974|r.

3.description: Reduces the Stamina cost of your Two-Handed abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

4.name: Follow Up
4.description: When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, your damage done with Two Handed attacks increases by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.

5.name: Battle Rush
5.description: Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds after killing a target.

6.name: Tri Focus
6.description:
Fully-charged Inferno Staff Heavy Attacks deal an additional |cffffff15130|r Flame Damage over |cffffff20|r seconds.

Fully-charged Lightning Staff Heavy Attacks damage nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage done.

Fully-charged Ice Staff Heavy Attacks grant you a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff8100|r damage. This effect scales off your Max Health.

While an Ice Staff is equipped, blocking costs Magicka instead of Stamina.

7.name: Penetrating Magic
7.description: Your Destruction Staff abilities ignore |cffffff2974|r of the enemy's Spell Resistance.

8.name: Elemental Force
8.description: Increases your chance to apply status effects by |cffffff100|r%.

9.name: Ancient Knowledge
9.description:
Inferno Staves increases your damage done with damage over time and Status Effects by |cffffff12|r%.

Lightning Staves increases your damage done with direct damage and channeled effects by |cffffff12|r%.

Equipping an Ice Staff reduces the cost of blocking by |cffffff36|r% and increases the amount of damage you block by |cffffff20|r%.

10.name: Destruction Expert
10.description:
When you kill an enemy with a Destruction Staff ability, you restore |cffffff3600|r Magicka.

When you absorb damage using a Destruction Staff Damage Shield, you restore |cffffff1800|r Magicka. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds.

Each piece of Light Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Light Armor worn.

19.name: Dexterity

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by |cffffff2|r% for every piece of Medium Armor equipped.

20.name: Wind Walker
20.description:
Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff4|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff28|r%.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff14|r%.

21.name: Improved Sneak
21.description:
Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff49|r%.

Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff5|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

22.name: Agility
22.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

23.name: Athletics
23.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses

Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

26.name: Resolve
26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

27.name: Constitution
27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

28.name: Juggernaut
28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

29.name: Revitalize
29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

30.name: Rapid Mending

Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

31.name: Hand Brush
31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF3|r layers of dirt or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

|cFFFFFFCan safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.|r

34.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.name: Improved Hiding

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2454|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Feed
54.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%

55.name: Dark Stalker
55.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Strike from the Shadows
56.description: When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff6|r seconds.

57.name: Undeath
57.description:
Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff15|r% based on your missing Health.

Current bonus: |cffffff6|r%

58.name: Blood Ritual
58.description:
Allows you to infect another player with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria once every |cffffffweek|r by returning to the Vampire ritual site. 

Players already infected with Lycanthropy cannot be infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria.

59.name: Unnatural Movement
59.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.

60.name: Blade of Woe
60.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

61.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
61.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

62.name: Padomaic Sprint
62.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

63.name: Shadowy Supplier
63.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

64.name: Shadow Rider
64.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

65.name: Spectral Assassin
65.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

66.name: Intimidating Presence
66.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Slayer
67.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

68.name: Banish the Wicked
68.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

69.name: Skilled Tracker
69.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

70.name: Bounty Hunter
70.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

71.name: Persuasive Will
71.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

72.name: Mage Adept
72.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

73.name: Everlasting Magic
73.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

74.name: Magicka Controller
74.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

75.name: Might of the Guild
75.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

76.name: See the Unseen
76.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

77.name: Clairvoyance
77.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

78.name: Spell Orb
78.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3784|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

79.name: Concentrated Barrier
79.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5000|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

80.name: Deliberation
80.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

81.name: Finders Keepers
81.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

82.name: Swiftly Forgotten
82.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

83.name: Haggling
83.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

84.name: Clemency
84.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

85.name: Timely Escape

Launch across the earth and smash an enemy, dealing |cffffff4692|r Physical Damage to them and all nearby enemies. This attack is always a Critical Strike.

2.description:
Devise a discharging rune under an enemy. After |cffffff2|r seconds the rune pulses, pulling in foes between 2 to 10 meters and etching them with scrawled glyphs that deal |cffffff16140|r Magic Damage over |cffffff18|r seconds.

Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff5292|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff2650|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff2120|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4909|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

3.name: Bright Harbinger

Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3681|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

19.name: Dexterity
19.description:
Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by |cffffff2|r% for every piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff14|r%.

20.name: Wind Walker
20.description:
Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff4|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff28|r%.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff14|r%.

21.name: Improved Sneak
21.description:
Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff49|r%.

Reduces the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff5|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff35|r%.

22.name: Agility
22.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff14|r%.

23.name: Athletics
23.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff21|r%.

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff28|r%.

24.name: Heavy Armor Bonuses
24.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the amount of damage blocked by |cffffff1|r%

Increases damage done with Bash by |cffffff30|r

Reduces your damage taken while immune to crowd control by |cffffff1|r%

25.name: Heavy Armor Penalties
25.description:
Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Increases the size of your detection area while Sneaking by |cffffff10|r%

26.name: Resolve
26.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

27.name: Constitution
27.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

You restore |cffffff108|r Magicka and Stamina when you take damage for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped. This effect can occur once every |cffffff4|r seconds. 

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r.

28.name: Juggernaut
28.description:
Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.  

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

29.name: Revitalize
29.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

30.name: Rapid Mending
30.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

31.name: Hand Brush
31.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF4|r.

32.name: Augur
32.description:
Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest six layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r

33.name: Trowel
33.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF3|r layers of dirt or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFCan safely trigger Fissures to create explosive chain reactions.|r

34.name: Keen Eye: Dig Sites
34.description: Antiquity Dig Sites will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

35.name: Excavator's Reserves
35.description: Further increases the amount of time you have available when excavating a dig site.

36.name: Heavy Shovel
36.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of dirt and rocks from up to a |cFFFFFF3x3|r area.

The shovel only affects a single contiguous height of dirt and rocks.

Costs |c19D3FF2 Intuition|r to use.
|cFFFFFFHas a chance to consume no Intuition on use.|r

37.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests
37.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.

38.name: Improved Hiding
38.description: Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff40|r%.

39.name: Light Fingers
39.description: Increases your chances of successfully Pickpocketing by |cffffff50|r%

40.name: Trafficker
40.description: Increases the number of fence interactions you can use each day by |cffffff180|r%.

41.name: Locksmith
41.description: Improves your chances of forcing locks by |cffffff70|r%.

42.name: Kickback
42.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff40|r%.

43.name: Scry
43.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.

44.name: Antiquarian Insight
44.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Ultimate difficulty.

45.name: Scrier's Patience
45.description: Grants you two additional turns of Scrying.

46.name: Coalescence
46.description:
Unites a hexagonal cluster of facets in the Antiquarian's Eye, converting the symbols to match that of the central facet.

New Effect: The ability's range increases by one facet, creating a snowflake-like pattern.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

47.name: Future Focus
47.description: Grants you two additional Magicka Charges for use in Scrying.

48.name: Dilation
48.description:
Claim all facets of the selected type that touch your area of control, as well as matching facets directly adjacent.

New Effect: Dilation now claims ALL contiguous facets of the same type.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

49.name: Farsight
49.description:
Claim a line of facets, stretching out from your area of control.

New Effect: Range increased from 4 facets to 6.

Consumes 1 Magicka Charge.

50.name: Preemptive Power
50.description: Start each Scrying attempt with an additional row of facets already claimed.

51.name: Soul Summons
51.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.

52.name: Soul Shatter
52.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff1939|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.

53.name: Soul Lock
53.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.

54.name: Feed
54.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%

55.name: Dark Stalker
55.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.

56.name: Strike from the Shadows
56.description: When you leave Sneak, invisibility, or Mist Form your Weapon and Spell Damage is increased by |cffffff300|r for |cffffff6|r seconds.

57.name: Undeath
57.description:
Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff15|r% based on your missing Health.

Current bonus: |cffffff1|r%

58.name: Blood Ritual
58.description:
Allows you to infect another player with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria once every |cffffffweek|r by returning to the Vampire ritual site. 

Players already infected with Lycanthropy cannot be infected with Noxiphilic Sanguivoria.

59.name: Unnatural Movement
59.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.

60.name: Blade of Woe
60.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.

61.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice
61.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.

62.name: Padomaic Sprint
62.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff12|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.

63.name: Shadowy Supplier
63.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.

64.name: Shadow Rider
64.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.

65.name: Spectral Assassin
65.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.

66.name: Intimidating Presence
66.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

67.name: Slayer
67.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff3|r% for each Fighters Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

68.name: Banish the Wicked
68.description: You generate |cffffff3|r Ultimate whenever you kill an enemy.

69.name: Skilled Tracker
69.description: Your Fighters Guild abilities deal an additional |cffffff10|r% damage. This bonus doubles against player Vampires and Werewolves.

70.name: Bounty Hunter
70.description: Allows you to accept bounty quests from the Fighters Guild in Cyrodiil.

71.name: Persuasive Will
71.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

72.name: Mage Adept
72.description: Reduces the Magicka and Health cost of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

73.name: Everlasting Magic
73.description: Increases the duration of your Mages Guild abilities by |cffffff2|r seconds.

74.name: Magicka Controller
74.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Magicka Recovery by |cffffff2|r% for each Mages Guild ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

75.name: Might of the Guild
75.description: Casting a Mages Guild ability grants you Empower, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds.

76.name: See the Unseen
76.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.

77.name: Clairvoyance
77.description: Reduces the cost of your Psijic Order abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

78.name: Spell Orb
78.description:
When you cast a Psijic Order ability while you are in combat, you generate a spell charge for |cffffff10|r seconds. When you reach |cffffff5|r spell charges, you launch a spell orb at the closest enemy to you dealing |cffffff3602|r Magic Damage.

This effect scales off your highest offensive stats.

79.name: Concentrated Barrier
79.description:
While you have a Psijic Order ability slotted and are Bracing, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff5000|r damage. 

This damage shield recharges back to full strength after you spend |cffffff10|r seconds not Bracing.

80.name: Deliberation
80.description: While you are casting or channeling a Psijic Order ability you reduce your damage taken by |cffffff30|r%.

81.name: Finders Keepers
81.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.

82.name: Swiftly Forgotten
82.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.

83.name: Haggling
83.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.

84.name: Clemency
84.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.

85.name: Timely Escape
85.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.

86.name: Veil of Shadows
86.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.

87.name: Undaunted Command
87.description:
Activating a synergy restores |cffffff4|r% of your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka.

Current Bonus: |cffffff837|r Health, |cffffff1027|r Stamina, and |cffffff618|r Magicka.

88.name: Undaunted Mettle
88.description:
Increases your Max Health, Stamina, and Magicka by |cffffff2|r% per type of Armor (Heavy, Medium, Light) that you have equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.

89.name: Continuous Attack
89.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff10|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.

90.name: Reach
90.description:
Increases the range of long-range abilities by |cffffff5|r meters while near a keep or outpost.

Any ability with a range greater than |cffffff28|r meters is affected.

91.name: Combat Frenzy
91.description: You generate |cffffff20|r Ultimate when you kill an enemy player.

92.name: Magicka Aid
92.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for each Support ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%.

93.name: Combat Medic
93.description: Increases your healing done by |cffffff20|r% when you are near a Keep.

94.name: Battle Resurrection
94.description: Reduces the time it takes you to resurrect another player by |cffffff30|r% while you are in a PvP area.

95.name: Amphibian
95.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Restoration Staff skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases your swimming speed by |cffffff50|r%.

97.name: Argonian Resistance
97.description: Increases your Max Health by |cffffff1000|r and your Disease and Poison Resistance by |cffffff2310|r.

98.name: Resourceful
98.description:
Increases your Max Magicka and Max Stamina by |cffffff1000|r.

When you drink a potion, you restore |cffffff3125|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina.

1.name: Recuperative Treatise
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff5|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3722|r Magic Damage, restores |cffffff600|r Magicka and Stamina, and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6215|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3399|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2817|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff9697|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff3722|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff8142|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Echoing Vigor
5.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff17730|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

6.name: The Tide King's Gaze
6.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff3690|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.

1.name: Master Assassin
1.description: Increases your Critical Chance rating against enemies you are flanking by |cffffff1448|r, increasing your chance to critically strike by |cffffff|6.6|r%.

2.name: Executioner
2.description: When an enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being damaged by you, you restore |cffffff1000|r Magicka and Stamina.

3.name: Pressure Points
3.description:
Increases your Critical Chance rating by |cffffff438|r for each Nightblade ability slotted, increasing your chance to critically strike by |cffffff2|r% per ability.

Current bonus: |cffffff438|r.

4.name: Hemorrhage
4.description:
Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%. 

Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff6|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.name: Fated Fortune
5.description: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff7|r seconds.

6.name: Harnessed Quintessence
6.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.

7.name: Psychic Lesion
7.description: Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by |cffffff15|r% and Status Effect Chance by |cffffff55|r%.

8.name: Splintered Secrets
8.description:
What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff1240|r per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff4960|r.
